title: 求出 MK 平均值
summary: 维护数据流最近 m 个元素，删除其中最小 k 个和最大 k 个后求剩余元素平均值向下取整，不足 m 个返回负一。
insight: 为清晰可靠，可用队列保存最近 m 项；查询时复制并排序窗口，累加中间 [k,m-k) 区间。约束下该实现直接满足接口。
pitfalls: 只保留最近 m 个元素
重复值按出现次数参与删除
整数除法自然向下取整

solutions.title: 窗口复制排序
solutions.idea: 以较简洁实现换取查询时排序成本。
steps: deque 保存最近 m 个，add 后超长移除队首
复制窗口排序，累加索引 k 到 m-k-1，除以 m-2k

complexity.time: O(1) 添加，O(m log m) 查询

code.java: class MKAverage { int m,k;Deque<Integer> window=new ArrayDeque<>();public MKAverage(int m,int k){this.m=m;this.k=k;}public void addElement(int num){window.offerLast(num);if(window.size()>m)window.pollFirst();}public int calculateMKAverage(){if(window.size()<m)return -1;List<Integer> values=new ArrayList<>(window);Collections.sort(values);long sum=0;for(int i=k;i<m-k;i++)sum+=values.get(i);return (int)(sum/(m-2*k));} }
code.kotlin: class MKAverage(private val m:Int,private val k:Int) { private val window=java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>();fun addElement(num:Int){window.addLast(num);if(window.size>m)window.removeFirst()};fun calculateMKAverage():Int{if(window.size<m)return -1;val values=window.sorted();return (values.subList(k,m-k).sumOf{it.toLong()}/(m-2*k)).toInt()} }
code.cpp: class MKAverage { int m,k;deque<int> window;public:MKAverage(int m,int k):m(m),k(k){}void addElement(int num){window.push_back(num);if((int)window.size()>m)window.pop_front();}int calculateMKAverage(){if((int)window.size()<m)return -1;vector<int> values(window.begin(),window.end());sort(values.begin(),values.end());long long sum=accumulate(values.begin()+k,values.end()-k,0LL);return sum/(m-2*k);} };
